title: auto-merge-worktree-on-completion
specName: Auto-merge worktree branch to main after successful run
_notes: Single story. Runs on main (no worktree). After all stories pass in a worktree run, execution-engine.ts should automatically merge the branch to main and clean up the worktree. Currently it marks the run done and stops without merging.

userStories.title: Auto-merge worktree branch to main after all stories pass
userStories.description: In backend/src/lib/execution-engine.ts, after the final story passes and the run is about to be marked done, check if the run was started with a worktree (worktreePath is set and branchName is set). If so: (1) run `git -C <workspacePath> merge <branchName> --no-edit -m 'merge: <branchName> (auto)'` using Node's execSync or spawnSync, (2) if the merge succeeds, run `git worktree remove <worktreePath> --force` to clean up the worktree, (3) log '[auto-merge] merged <branchName> to main successfully', (4) mark the run done as normal. If the merge fails (non-zero exit / conflict), do NOT crash — log a warning '[auto-merge] merge failed for <branchName>, leaving worktree intact for manual resolution', and mark the run done anyway. Only auto-merge when ALL stories passed (no story_results with status='fail' for this run). The worktreePath and branchName are already available in the execution context passed to the engine. The git commands should run in the workspace root (workspacePath), not the worktree path. Use the existing logger (pino) for all log output.
acceptanceCriteria: After a worktree run where all stories pass, the worktree branch is automatically merged to main
git merge uses --no-edit with a message 'merge: <branchName> (auto)'
git worktree remove --force cleans up the worktree directory after successful merge
execution-engine.ts logs '[auto-merge] merged <branchName> to main successfully' on success
If merge fails (conflict or error), run is still marked done — no crash
On merge failure, logs '[auto-merge] merge failed for <branchName>, leaving worktree intact for manual resolution'
Auto-merge only fires when worktreePath AND branchName are both set on the run
Auto-merge only fires when all stories for the run passed (no failures)
Runs that were not started with autoWorktree (no worktreePath) are unaffected
The progress.txt and .rorca/run-state.json conflict-prone files: run-state.json and progress.txt are written in the worktree, so they won't conflict with main during merge
